build_fused_moe_layer: build a FusedMoE layer for MoE models with expert parallelism and quantization support
create_expert_map: create an expert map tensor that maps global expert indices to local indices across EP ranks
determine_expert_placement: determine the expert placement strategy for MoE layers with round-robin or linear distribution
compress_expert_map: compress an expert map tensor into a human-readable string mapping local to global indices
load_moe_weights: load MoE layer weights from checkpoint with TP sharding, expert mapping, and quantization handling
